# betterado_users (Data Source)

Looks up Azure DevOps users with optional filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all users originating from Azure AD.
data "betterado_users" "aad_users" {
  origin = "aad"
}

output "aad_user_count" {
  value = length(data.betterado_users.aad_users.users)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `origin` (String) Filter by origin (e.g. aad, msa). Conflicts with principal_name.
- `origin_id` (String) Filter by origin ID. Conflicts with principal_name.
- `principal_name` (String) Filter by principal name (conflicts with origin).
- `subject_types` (Set of String) Optional set of subject types to filter (e.g. ["aad"]).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A hash of the returned user descriptors.
- `users` (Attributes Set) The set of matching users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `descriptor` (String) The descriptor of the user.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the user.
- `id` (String) The storage key UUID of the user.
- `mail_address` (String) The mail address of the user.
- `origin` (String) The origin of the user.
- `origin_id` (String) The origin-specific identifier of the user.
- `principal_name` (String) The principal name of the user.
